title: Healthy Kids Care Management Reward
content:
# Healthy Kids Care Management Reward

Care management team training note — Healthy Kids rewards on the Medicaid Managed Care Membership CHIP family premium.

## The rule the team explains

The Healthy Kids care reward follows care management: where the member holds an active care management episode and the care team recorded at least one reached contact in the care contact window months before the review date, the reward is the engaged-care amount; where the member holds an active episode with no reached contact in that window, the reward is the enrolled-care amount; otherwise there is no care reward.

- Care contact window: **the 3 months before the review date**.
- Engaged-care amount: **$2.50**.
- Enrolled-care amount: **$1.00**.

The reward is one of the Healthy Kids rewards credited on the premium month the family pays.

## Questions answered

**Which records decide the reward?**
The member's Care Management records: whether an episode is active, and the care team's recorded contacts with their outcome and activity date.

**What is a reached contact?**
A contact the care team recorded with the outcome reached. Attempts recorded with any other outcome are not reached contacts.

**The child has an active episode and the care team reached the family 2 months before the review date. What is the reward?** (hypothetical)
The contact lies in the 3-month window and the episode is active: $2.50.

**The child has an active episode and the last reached contact was 4 months before the review date.** (hypothetical)
No reached contact lies in the window; the episode is active: $1.00.

**The child's episode has closed, though the care team reached the family last month.** (hypothetical)
There is no active episode, so there is no care reward.

## Tiers at a glance

| Active care management episode | Reached contact in the 3 months before the review date | Care reward |
|---|---|---|
| yes | at least one | $2.50 |
| yes | none | $1.00 |
| no | any | none |
